verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a case management solution for prioritising and reviewing risk alerts (docs-3). Cases can be filtered by customer risk, stage, assignee or creation date (docs-6), resolved with case decisions (docs-7), and worked in the web app or via the API (docs-14). There is no evidence that analysts can group multiple related subjects and transactions into a single investigation; cases appear tied to individual customer screening alerts. Missing for 10: grouping multiple subjects into one investigation, linking transactions to cases, explicit alert-prioritisation mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
